sampling: Uniform eligible arrival event, then uniform real resident; sampling with replacement; no IDs used as predictors
target: Y96: resident actual exit precedes incoming actual exit within 96 hours
queue_definition: Current live same-vessel residents excluding historically missed LOAD IDs; divide by full next loading-window hours, minimum denominator 1
rotation_definition: Equality of public vessel and next rotation end; both must have an assigned rotation
port_weight_diff: Resident minus incoming normalized port/weight loading-order fraction, same vessel only
raw_etd_minus_s3: Raw ETD minus fraction-adjusted expected S3 loading timestamp
